content: {"summary":"The catalog‑api connection pool was exhausted because a migration’s ALTER TABLE waited for an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock that was blocked by a long‑running weekly export transaction, causing all incoming SELECT/UPDATE queries to hold pool connections until the lock was released, which triggered QueuePool limit errors and edge 504 responses.","likely_cause":"ALTER TABLE migration blocked by export transaction lock, causing query‑backed connections to fill the pool","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The migration’s ALTER TABLE needed an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock that conflicted with the export’s lock","evidence_ids":["RB-028#2"],"quote":"needs an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, ... conflicts with the export's lock"},{"text":"Every new SELECT or UPDATE waited behind the ALTER, holding a pool connection","evidence_ids":["RB-028#2","RB-028#4"],"quote":"every new SELECT or UPDATE on products waited behind the ALTER"},{"text":"30 catalog_app sessions were blocked by the ALTER’s pid, filling the pool","evidence_ids":["RB-028#4"],"quote":"30 catalog_app sessions, each blocked by the ALTER's pid"},{"text":"QueuePool limit of size 10 overflow 5 was reached, causing connection timeouts and edge 504s","evidence_ids":["RB-028#3"],"quote":"QueuePool limit of size 10 overflow 5 reached, connection timed out"}],"next_checks":["Confirm the exact start and end timestamps of the export transaction","Check migration logs to see when the ALTER was cancelled","Monitor lock wait events on the products table during similar load spikes","Validate that no other background jobs were holding connections at the same time"]}
